name: Everforest Material
notes: A Zed theme (lib/zed.mjs translates it). The canonical Everforest is sainnhe/everforest; this is albertsko's Zed port, picked for its "material" variant.

material differs from the port's regular variant only in Zed chrome (panels, tabs and bars on bg0 instead of bg1/bg2). Syntax and terminal colors are the same, so the terminal tools mostly look like plain Everforest.
orange: the port's warning color is yellow; Everforest's orange is what it uses for operators.

bgActive: material puts every raised surface on bg0 (the editor background), leaving only the green hover tint. Helix popups and the statusline need a raised surface, so this uses bg2, which the port also uses for indent guides in every variant.

Light variants: the port swaps terminal black and white (black is a pale surface, white is the foreground), so text programs print in black disappeared. Swapped back: black = fg, white/brightWhite = bg2.
